title: 第4章 四象神功
content_zh:
“小家伙，你说你的小仙女漂亮，还是我们师姐妹漂亮？”沈翔的脑海中突然出现一道娇媚的声音，这是苏媚瑶的声音。

沈翔干咳两声，笑道：“只要是我的妻子都漂亮，嘿嘿，你们当然也很漂亮……对了，媚瑶姐你得快点传授我那些神功，还有炼丹什么的。”

“混小子，你这是什么意思？”苏媚瑶娇啐道。

“没啥……”沈翔挠头傻笑着，眼眸中闪过一抹异样的光芒。

为了不让薛仙仙失望，沈翔打算日夜不眠，加倍努力去修炼！

沈翔那带着隐形戒指的手指突然闪烁起一丝微弱的光芒，只见白幽幽和苏媚瑶出现在他的面前，她们身上都穿着紫色的衣裙，闲得更加高贵端庄，沈翔猜测这是存放在那戒指里面的。

此时是下午，太阳十分毒辣，但两个绝色女子却好像十分享受这种让人讨厌的毒辣阳光。

“这里的灵气真差，不依靠丹药的话，难以进入真武境！”苏媚瑶仰头望着烈阳，低喃着。

沈翔有些头大，这两个女人竟然可以自由的初入那枚戒指，而且她们还能听到外面的声音。

沈翔跟着她们进入了那小宅子，里面不是很大，只有一个厅四间房，在偌大的沈家来说算是很小的了。

小厅中，苏媚瑶和白幽幽喝着沈翔泡的灵茶，这可是沈翔珍藏的东西，平时他自己都舍不得喝。

“在这种灵气稀薄的地方，你要快速提升的话只有通过丹药了，不过在此之前，你得先修炼出真气之火来，你有阴阳神脉，这对你来说并不是很难。”苏媚瑶说道。

沈翔点了点头，说道：“还请媚瑶姐指教。”

“你过来，我先传授你太极神功和四象神功。”苏媚瑶娇声说道，她抚着秀发，煞是风情万种，因为沈翔有着无限的潜力，苏媚瑶也想好好把他培养起来，这样以后她也能有一个厉害的帮手。

苏媚瑶把纤手捂在沈翔的额头上，然后闭上淹没，而沈翔的脑海中也出现了许多文字，每一句都晦涩难懂，但后来他又不知不觉地融会贯通了。

苏媚瑶说道：“这是我用神识给你传功，我不仅仅把神功传给你，还把我对神功的理解传给你，所以你只要照着修炼就行了！”

沈翔心中微微惊讶着，他没想到这苏媚瑶竟然还能使用“神识”，神识是凡武境六重才能修炼出来的，是精神力和真力融合在一起诞生的，是一种无形无态的精神力量，十分神异。

“对于我们的事情你一定要保密，绝不能告诉人任何人，包括你那小妻子！”白幽幽神情严肃，冷冷说道。

苏媚瑶说道：“我可以告诉你，我和师姐的仇人很多，我们那些仇人随便一个都能用手指头捏死你，所以你必须要保密！而我们也不会随便从戒指里面出来。”

沈翔心中惊骇，他没想到自己竟然收容了两个这么危险的女人，他急忙点了点头，而白幽幽和苏媚瑶也突然消失，进入了那戒指里面。

太极神功，四象神功！虽然只是一小部分而已，但沈翔却激动无比，毕竟不是什么人都能修炼神功的！

在这个武道世界中，武功分为凡级，灵级、玄级、地级、天级、圣级、神级，又分上下乘，丹药也是如此划分，只不过是分为上中下三品。

天级的武功都是非常难得了，神级武功就更加稀有！

神功，那可是传说中神明修炼的神功，强大无比，修炼之后，能拥有翻江倒海，召唤雷电的力量，甚至还能逆天改命，破碎虚空，登天成神！

太极神功是主功法，是专门练气练体用的，是一门非常深奥而且强大的武功心法。

而四象神功分为四部分，分别是青龙神功，白虎神功，朱雀神功，玄武神功，包罗万象，这四门神功是攻击或者防御的辅助型武功，修炼之后，能施展强大的武技。

沈翔来到后院，那些青翠欲滴的树木，呼吸着清新的空气，他此时能非常清晰的感应到天地间的五行灵气。

普通的灵脉是分属性的，而沈翔的阴阳神脉却代表着天地五行，所以他能修炼五行真气！

太极神功虽然是玄奥的练功心法，但经过苏媚瑶的神识传功之后，沈翔能融会贯通。他运转太极神功，他丹田中的太极阴阳图就立即旋转起来，天地灵气顿时狂涌入他的身体之中。

上品灵脉吸收灵气的速度都非常之快了，神脉就更加不用说！此时沈翔盘腿坐在洞口运转着太极神功，灵气进入他的身体，立即被他提纯，化成一股纯白色的暖流，在他身体的骨骼、肌肉、经脉中游走，蕴养着他的身体内部。

想要成为一个强大的武者，就要内外兼修。沈翔现在就是在强化身体内部，使他身体内部诞生出一种蕴含强大力量的气流，也就是真气！

沈翔不知不觉进入了修炼状态之中，灵气疯狂涌入沈翔的身体中，如果有人看见，一定会认为被吓得一大跳。

拥有阴阳神脉和太极神功，能让他快速吸收天地灵气，而太极神功能快速炼化灵气为真气，因此他才能突飞猛进。

而沈翔如今拥有的太极神功和四象神功都是神级武功，他要发挥出神功的威力，就得拥有更加浑厚的真气。

青龙神功和白虎神功是攻击力最强的，朱雀神功主要是火焰方面，玄武神功就是防御。

修炼真气到大乘，能在丹田中凝聚出形态，如果沈翔修炼四象神功的话，到时候他会在丹田内凝聚出青龙、朱雀、白虎、玄武，这四尊神兽之象！

这意味着沈翔一个人却要修炼四个人的份量，虽然会让他很辛苦，但他掌握的力量却要超乎常人。

大量的灵气涌入他的身体之中，被他运转太极神功简直炼化成精纯的真气！真气流动在他身体内的大小脉络之中，让他身体内的经脉变得更加粗壮。

次日清晨，温暖宜人的阳光射入在小宅子的后院，照在沈翔的身上。沈翔睁开眼睛，双目如电，缭绕在他身体外面的白色雾气顿时散开，只见他的身上满是黑色的污渍，他此时已经进入了凡武境第四重！

凡武境四到六重又是一个阶段，如今沈翔到达了第四重，通脉境！迈过了一道困扰着他多年的坎。

沈翔双目微微闭上，凝神内视着他丹田里面的那副太极阴阳图，发现太极阴阳图里面出现了五个真气漩涡，分别在四方和中心！而平常人只有一个，他现在却有五个！他真气的浑厚程度可想而知。

凭借他的真气浑厚程度，他的实力能直逼凡武境五重。

“终于迈入凡武境四重了，老子以后不用去采药给那些老家伙了！”沈翔心中狂喜，只是一夜之间他就突破了。

而当他想到薛仙仙十五岁就进入了凡武境六重，他心情又平静下来，想到药家那年轻的天才炼药师打他未婚妻的主意，沈翔心中一狠，他要更加发奋修炼，然后前往药家，用挑战的方式把那天才炼丹师打败。

“现在就开始修炼青龙神功！”苏媚瑶说道，她的神识恢复了不少，能洞察到外面的变化。

四象神功总的来说只是一门神功而已，但其中却包罗万象，里面就包涵着拳法，掌法、腿法、轻功、等等，融会贯通之后，想怎么施展就怎么施展，玄妙无穷。

青龙是木属性的，木属性中又有风和雷属，所以修炼青龙神功能施展出具有风雷力量的武功来。

沈翔清洗身体，饱餐一顿之后，就来到后院中继续修炼青龙神功！

太极神功和四象神功已融入了他的灵魂之中，不管是多么高深玄奥，他都能理解！

半天过去，沈翔按照青龙神功去运转体内的真气，只见他的身体溢出一阵青色柔光，青光之中闪烁着丝丝雷电，同时还有一阵轻风从沈翔的身体中轻飘出来。

沈翔现在已经掌握了从木属性的真气之中释放出雷电和风的力量来，只不过这种程度还不够，要能将木属性真气转化为强大的雷电和狂风才能施展青龙神功中的武技。

沈翔控制着体内的木属性真气以一种奇异的方式流动在身体的经脉之中，循环流动着，真气流动的方式飞诡异，时快时慢，有时候如同大江奔流一般的冲刺，有时候又如溪水潺潺……

content_en:
"Little guy, do you think your little fairy is beautiful, or our senior sisters?" A charming voice suddenly appeared in Chen Xiang's mind. This was Su Meiyao's voice.

Chen Xiang coughed twice and said with a smile: "As long as she is my wife, she is beautiful. Hehe, of course you are also very beautiful... By the way, Sister Meiyao, you have to teach me those magical skills quickly, as well as alchemy and so on."

"You bastard, what do you mean?" Su Meiyao spat.

"Nothing..." Chen Xiang scratched his head and smiled stupidly, a strange light flashed in his eyes.

In order not to disappoint Xue Xianxian, Chen Xiang plans to stay awake day and night and work harder to practice!

Chen Xiang's finger with the invisible ring suddenly flickered with a faint light, and Bai Youyou and Su Meiyao appeared in front of him. They were both wearing purple dresses, looking more noble and dignified when they were leisurely. Chen Xiang guessed that they were stored in the ring.

It was afternoon, and the sun was very scorching, but the two stunning women seemed to enjoy this annoying scorching sunshine.

"The spiritual energy here is really bad. It would be difficult to enter the True Martial Realm without relying on elixirs!" Su Meiyao murmured, looking up at the blazing sun.

Chen Xiang was a little confused, but these two women were able to enter the ring freely, and they could also hear the sounds outside.

Chen Xiang followed them into the small house. It was not very big inside, with only one living room and four rooms, which was considered very small for the huge Shen family.

In the small hall, Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou drank the spiritual tea made by Chen Xiang. This was Chen Xiang's treasure, and he was usually reluctant to drink it.

"In such a place with thin spiritual energy, if you want to improve quickly, you can only use elixirs. But before that, you have to cultivate the fire of true energy. You have the yin and yang divine veins, which is not difficult for you." Su Meiyao said.

Chen Xiang nodded and said, "Please give me some advice from Sister Meiyao."

"Come here, I will teach you the Tai Chi Magic Skill and the Four Elephants Magic Skill first." Su Meiyao said softly, stroking her hair, she was very charming, because Chen Xiang has unlimited potential, Su Meiyao also wants to train him well, so that she can have a powerful helper in the future.

Su Meiyao put her delicate hands on Shen Xiang's forehead, then closed it and drowned it out, while many words appeared in Chen Xiang's mind, each sentence was obscure and difficult to understand, but later he understood it unknowingly.

Su Meiyao said: "This is me using my spiritual consciousness to teach you the skills. I not only pass on the magic skills to you, but also my understanding of the magic skills, so you only need to practice according to them!"

Chen Xiang was slightly surprised. He did not expect that Su Meiyao could actually use "divine consciousness". Divine consciousness can only be cultivated at the sixth level of the mortal martial arts realm. It is born from the fusion of mental power and real power. It is an invisible and stateless spiritual power that is very miraculous.

"You must keep our affairs a secret and never tell anyone, including your little wife!" Bai Youyou said coldly with a serious expression.

Su Meiyao said: "I can tell you that senior sister and I have many enemies. Any of our enemies can crush you to death with their fingers, so you must keep it a secret! And we will not come out of the ring casually."

Chen Xiang was horrified. He did not expect that he would take in two such dangerous women. He nodded hastily, and Bai Youyou and Su Meiyao suddenly disappeared and entered the ring.

The magical power of Tai Chi and the magical power of the Four Symbols!Although it was only a small part, Chen Xiang was extremely excited. After all, not everyone can practice magic!

In this world of martial arts, martial arts are divided into ordinary levels, spiritual levels, mysterious levels, earth levels, heaven levels, holy levels, and divine levels, and are further divided into upper and lower levels. Pills are also divided in the same way, but they are divided into upper, middle and lower levels.

Heaven-level martial arts are very rare, and god-level martial arts are even rarer!

Magical skills are the magical skills practiced by the legendary gods. They are extremely powerful. After practicing them, you can have the power to overturn rivers and seas, summon thunder and lightning, and even change your fate against the will of heaven, shatter the void, and ascend to the sky to become a god!

Tai Chi magic is the main method, which is specially used to practice Qi and body. It is a very profound and powerful martial arts mental method.

The Four Elephant Magic Skills are divided into four parts, namely the Azure Dragon Magic Skill, the White Tiger Magic Skill, the Suzaku Magic Skill, and the Xuanwu Magic Skill, which are all-encompassing. These four magical skills are auxiliary martial arts for attack or defense. After practicing, you can display powerful martial arts.

Chen Xiang came to the backyard, where the green trees were breathing the fresh air. At this time, he could very clearly sense the five elements of spiritual energy between heaven and earth.

Ordinary spiritual veins have different attributes, but Chen Xiang's yin and yang divine veins represent the five elements of heaven and earth, so he can cultivate the five elements of true energy!

Although the Tai Chi magic skill is a mysterious training method, Chen Xiang can understand it after passing it through Su Meiyao's spiritual consciousness.He used the Tai Chi magic skill, and the Tai Chi yin and yang diagram in his Dantian immediately rotated, and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth suddenly poured into his body.

High-grade spiritual veins absorb spiritual energy very quickly, not to mention divine veins!At this time, Chen Xiang was sitting cross-legged at the entrance of the cave, performing Tai Chi magic. The spiritual energy entered his body and was immediately purified by him, turning into a pure white warm current that traveled through the bones, muscles, and meridians of his body, nourishing the inside of his body.

If you want to become a powerful warrior, you must cultivate both internally and externally.Chen Xiang is currently strengthening the inside of his body, so that a powerful air flow containing powerful force is born inside his body, which is true energy!

Chen Xiang entered a state of cultivation unknowingly, and spiritual energy poured into Chen Xiang's body crazily. If anyone saw it, they would definitely think they were shocked.

Possessing the yin and yang divine veins and the Tai Chi magical power allow him to quickly absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and the Tai Chi divine power quickly refines the spiritual energy into true energy, so he can advance by leaps and bounds.

The Tai Chi Magic Skill and the Four Symbol Magic Skills that Chen Xiang currently possesses are both god-level martial arts. If he wants to exert the power of the magic skills, he must have a stronger Qi.

The Green Dragon Magic and White Tiger Magic are the most powerful in attack, the Suzaku Magic is mainly about flames, and the Xuanwu Magic is about defense.

After cultivating Qi to the Mahayana level, one can condense forms in the Dantian. If Chen Xiang practices the Four Elephants Divine Art, he will then condense the four images of the sacred beasts in the Dantian: Qinglong, Suzaku, White Tiger, and Xuanwu!

This means that Chen Xiang has to train as much as four people by himself. Although it will be very hard for him, the power he has is beyond ordinary people.

A large amount of spiritual energy poured into his body, and was refined into pure true energy by his Tai Chi magic!The true energy flows through the large and small meridians in his body, making the meridians in his body stronger.

Early the next morning, the warm and pleasant sunshine shone into the backyard of the small house and shone on Shen Xiang's body.Chen Xiang opened his eyes, his eyes were like lightning. The white mist surrounding his body immediately dissipated, revealing that his body was covered with black stains. He had now entered the fourth level of the mortal martial realm!

The fourth to sixth levels of the Mortal Martial Realm are another stage, and now Chen Xiang has reached the fourth level, the Tongmai Realm!He passed a hurdle that had troubled him for many years.

Chen Xiang closed his eyes slightly and looked at the Tai Chi Yin and Yang diagram in his Dantian. He found that there were five true energy vortexes in the Tai Chi Yin and Yang diagram, one in the four directions and the other in the center!While ordinary people only have one, he now has five!One can imagine the depth of his true energy.

With the strength of his true energy, his strength can reach the fifth level of the mortal martial realm.

"I finally entered the fourth level of the Mortal Martial Realm. I don't have to collect medicine for those old guys anymore!" Chen Xiang was ecstatic in his heart. He made a breakthrough overnight.

And when he thought that Xue Xianxian had entered the sixth level of the Mortal Martial Realm at the age of fifteen, he calmed down again. Thinking of the young genius alchemist from the Yao family trying to trick his fiancée, Chen Xiang felt cruel in his heart. He would practice harder and then go to the Yao family to defeat the talented alchemist with a challenge.

"Start practicing the Qinglong Divine Art now!" Su Meiyao said. Her consciousness had recovered a lot and she could see the changes outside.

Generally speaking, the Four Symbols Divine Skill is just a magical skill, but it is all-encompassing. It includes boxing skills, palm skills, leg skills, light skills, etc. After mastering it, you can use it however you want. It is infinitely mysterious.

The green dragon is of the wood attribute, and the wood attribute also has wind and thunder attributes, so practicing the green dragon's divine power allows you to perform martial arts with the power of wind and thunder.

After Chen Xiang cleaned his body and had a hearty meal, he went to the backyard to continue practicing the Qinglong Magic Technique!

The Tai Chi Magic Skill and the Four Symbol Magic Skills have been integrated into his soul. No matter how profound and mysterious it is, he can understand it!

After half a day passed, Chen Xiang used the Qinglong Divine Art to circulate the Qi in his body. He saw a burst of soft cyan light coming out of his body. There were traces of thunder and lightning flashing in the cyan light, and at the same time, there was a gust of wind floating out of Chen Xiang's body.

Chen Xiang has now mastered the power of releasing thunder, lightning and wind from the wood-attributed Qi, but this level is not enough. He must be able to transform the wood-attributed Qi into powerful thunder, lightning and wind in order to perform the martial arts in the Qinglong Divine Art.

Chen Xiang controlled the wood attribute Qi in his body to flow in the meridians of the body in a strange way, circulating in a strange way. The Qi flowed in strange ways, sometimes fast and sometimes slow. Sometimes it was like a rushing river, sometimes it was like a gurgling stream...
